units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 18b:12">Snh. 18ᵇ</cite> (as a rule for appointing the Spring month, v. <cite ref="A00109"><he>אָבִיב</he></cite>) <he>אם קידום … י׳ בלועך נפיק לקיבליה וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>רפח מלועך</he>, corr. acc.; oth. Var. v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) when the East wind is ever so strong, and a blow out of thy cheek goes out to meet it (i.e. if a person feels the warmth of thy breath blown against the East wind),—such is Adar (and no Adar Sheni is to be intercalated); Y. ib. I, 18ᶜ bot. <he>פה בלועה יפיק וכ׳</he> (read: <he>פח בלועך</he>); Y. R. Hash. I, 58ᵇ top <he>פוח לוחיך ופוק וכ׳</he> blow up thy cheek &c.
